using JSON

struct StructureConfidenceFullEncoder
end

function encode(encoder::StructureConfidenceFullEncoder, o)
    atom_plddts = round.(clamp.(Float64.(o.atom_plddts), 0.0, 99.99), digits=2)
    contact_probs = round.(clamp.(Float64.(o.contact_probs), 0.0, 1.0), digits=2)
    pae = round.(clamp.(Float64.(o.pae), 0.0, 99.9), digits=1)
    
    atom_plddts_str = replace(JSON.json(collect(atom_plddts)), "null" => "null")
    contact_probs_str = replace(JSON.json([collect(x) for x in eachrow(contact_probs)]), "null" => "null")
    pae_str = replace(JSON.json([collect(x) for x in eachrow(pae)]), "null" => "null")
    
    return """{
"atom_chain_ids": $(JSON.json(o.atom_chain_ids)),
"atom_plddts": $(atom_plddts_str),
"contact_probs": $(contact_probs_str),
"pae": $(pae_str),
"token_chain_ids": $(JSON.json(o.token_chain_ids)),
"token_res_ids": $(JSON.json(o.token_res_ids))
}"""
end

function _dump_json(data, indent=nothing)
    json_str = if indent === nothing
        JSON.json(data, indent=nothing)
    else
        JSON.json(data, indent=indent)
    end
    return replace(json_str, "NaN" => "null")
end

@enum ConfidenceCategory HIGH=0 MEDIUM=1 LOW=2 DISORDERED=3

function from_char(::Type{ConfidenceCategory}, char::String)
    if char == "H"
        return HIGH
    elseif char == "M"
        return MEDIUM
    elseif char == "L"
        return LOW
    elseif char == "D"
        return DISORDERED
    else
        error("Unknown character. Expected one of H, M, L or D; got: $char")
    end
end

function to_char(cat::ConfidenceCategory)
    if cat == HIGH
        return "H"
    elseif cat == MEDIUM
        return "M"
    elseif cat == LOW
        return "L"
    elseif cat == DISORDERED
        return "D"
    end
end

function from_confidence_score(::Type{ConfidenceCategory}, confidence::Float64)
    if 90 <= confidence <= 100
        return HIGH
    elseif 70 <= confidence < 90
        return MEDIUM
    elseif 50 <= confidence < 70
        return LOW
    elseif 0 <= confidence < 50
        return DISORDERED
    else
        error("Confidence score out of range [0, 100]: $confidence")
    end
end

mutable struct AtomConfidence
    chain_id::Vector{String}
    atom_number::Vector{Int}
    confidence::Vector{Float64}
    confidence_category::Vector{ConfidenceCategory}
    
    function AtomConfidence(chain_id, atom_number, confidence, confidence_category)
        num_res = length(atom_number)
        if !(length(chain_id) == num_res && length(confidence) == num_res && length(confidence_category) == num_res)
            error("All confidence fields must have the same length.")
        end
        new(chain_id, atom_number, confidence, confidence_category)
    end
end

function from_inference_result(::Type{AtomConfidence}, inference_result)
    struc = inference_result.predicted_structure
    as_dict = Dict(
        "chain_id" => String[],
        "atom_number" => Int[],
        "confidence" => Float64[],
        "confidence_category" => ConfidenceCategory[]
    )
    
    for (atom_number, atom) in enumerate(struc.iter_atoms())
        this_confidence = Float64(struc.atom_b_factor[atom_number])
        push!(as_dict["chain_id"], atom["chain_id"])
        push!(as_dict["atom_number"], atom_number)
        push!(as_dict["confidence"], round(this_confidence, digits=2))
        push!(as_dict["confidence_category"], from_confidence_score(ConfidenceCategory, this_confidence))
    end
    
    return AtomConfidence(as_dict["chain_id"], as_dict["atom_number"], as_dict["confidence"], as_dict["confidence_category"])
end

function from_json(::Type{AtomConfidence}, json_string::String)
    input_dict = JSON.parse(json_string)
    input_dict["confidence_category"] = [from_char(ConfidenceCategory, k) for k in input_dict["confidence_category"]]
    return AtomConfidence(input_dict["chain_id"], input_dict["atom_number"], input_dict["confidence"], input_dict["confidence_category"])
end

function to_json(ac::AtomConfidence)
    output = Dict(
        "chain_id" => ac.chain_id,
        "atom_number" => Int.(ac.atom_number),
        "confidence" => ac.confidence,
        "confidence_category" => [to_char(k) for k in ac.confidence_category]
    )
    return _dump_json(output)
end

struct StructureConfidenceSummary
    ptm::Float64
    iptm::Float64
    ranking_score::Float64
    fraction_disordered::Float64
    has_clash::Float64
    chain_pair_pae_min::Array{Float64}
    chain_pair_iptm::Array{Float64}
    chain_ptm::Array{Float64}
    chain_iptm::Array{Float64}
end

function from_inference_result(::Type{StructureConfidenceSummary}, inference_result)
    return StructureConfidenceSummary(
        Float64(inference_result.metadata["ptm"]),
        Float64(inference_result.metadata["iptm"]),
        Float64(inference_result.metadata["ranking_score"]),
        Float64(inference_result.metadata["fraction_disordered"]),
        Float64(inference_result.metadata["has_clash"]),
        inference_result.metadata["chain_pair_pae_min"],
        inference_result.metadata["chain_pair_iptm"],
        inference_result.metadata["iptm_ichain"],
        inference_result.metadata["iptm_xchain"]
    )
end

function from_json(::Type{StructureConfidenceSummary}, json_string::String)
    data = JSON.parse(json_string)
    return StructureConfidenceSummary(
        data["ptm"],
        data["iptm"],
        data["ranking_score"],
        data["fraction_disordered"],
        data["has_clash"],
        data["chain_pair_pae_min"],
        data["chain_pair_iptm"],
        data["chain_ptm"],
        data["chain_iptm"]
    )
end

function to_json(scs::StructureConfidenceSummary)
    function convert_data(data)
        if isa(data, Array)
            rounded_data = round.(Float64.(data), digits=2)
            return rounded_data
        else
            return round(data, digits=2)
        end
    end
    
    dict_data = Dict(
        "ptm" => convert_data(scs.ptm),
        "iptm" => convert_data(scs.iptm),
        "ranking_score" => convert_data(scs.ranking_score),
        "fraction_disordered" => convert_data(scs.fraction_disordered),
        "has_clash" => convert_data(scs.has_clash),
        "chain_pair_pae_min" => convert_data(scs.chain_pair_pae_min),
        "chain_pair_iptm" => convert_data(scs.chain_pair_iptm),
        "chain_ptm" => convert_data(scs.chain_ptm),
        "chain_iptm" => convert_data(scs.chain_iptm)
    )
    
    return _dump_json(dict_data, 1)
end

struct StructureConfidenceFull
    pae::Array{Float64}
    token_chain_ids::Vector{String}
    token_res_ids::Vector{Int}
    atom_plddts::Vector{Float64}
    atom_chain_ids::Vector{String}
    contact_probs::Array{Float64}
end

function from_inference_result(::Type{StructureConfidenceFull}, inference_result)
    pae = inference_result.numerical_data["full_pae"]
    if !isa(pae, Array)
        error("pae should be a numpy array.")
    end
    
    contact_probs = inference_result.numerical_data["contact_probs"]
    if !isa(contact_probs, Array)
        error("contact_probs should be a numpy array.")
    end
    
    struc = inference_result.predicted_structure
    chain_ids = collect(struc.chain_id)
    atom_plddts = collect(struc.atom_b_factor)
    
    token_chain_ids = [string(token_id) for token_id in inference_result.metadata["token_chain_ids"]]
    token_res_ids = [Int(token_id) for token_id in inference_result.metadata["token_res_ids"]]
    
    return StructureConfidenceFull(
        pae,
        token_chain_ids,
        token_res_ids,
        atom_plddts,
        chain_ids,
        contact_probs
    )
end

function from_json(::Type{StructureConfidenceFull}, json_string::String)
    data = JSON.parse(json_string)
    return StructureConfidenceFull(
        data["pae"],
        data["token_chain_ids"],
        data["token_res_ids"],
        data["atom_plddts"],
        data["atom_chain_ids"],
        data["contact_probs"]
    )
end

function to_json(scf::StructureConfidenceFull)
    encoder = StructureConfidenceFullEncoder()
    return encode(encoder, scf)
end

using Printf

const _CCD_PICKLE_FILE = "constants/converters/ccd.pickle"

function find_ions_and_glycans_in_ccd(ccd::Dict{String, Dict{String, Vector{String}}})
    glycans_linking = String[]
    glycans_other = String[]
    ions = String[]
    
    for (name, comp) in ccd
        if name == "UNX"
            continue
        end
        
        comp_type = lowercase(comp["_chem_comp.type"][1])
        
        if occursin(r"\bsaccharide\b", comp_type)
            if occursin("linking", comp_type)
                push!(glycans_linking, name)
            else
                push!(glycans_other, name)
            end
        end
        
        comp_name = lowercase(comp["_chem_comp.name"][1])
        if occursin(r"\bion\b", comp_name)
            push!(ions, name)
        end
    end
    
    result = Dict(
        "glycans_linking" => Set(glycans_linking),
        "glycans_other" => Set(glycans_other),
        "ions" => Set(ions)
    )
    
    return result
end

function main(argv::Vector{String})
    if length(argv) != 2
        error("Directory to write to must be specified as a command-line arguments.")
    end
    
    println("Loading $_CCD_PICKLE_FILE")
    flush(stdout)
    ccd = open(_CCD_PICKLE_FILE, "r") do f
        deserialize(f)
    end
    
    output_path = argv[2]
    mkpath(dirname(output_path))
    
    println("Finding ions and glycans")
    flush(stdout)
    result = find_ions_and_glycans_in_ccd(ccd)
    
    println("writing to $output_path")
    flush(stdout)
    open(output_path, "w") do f
        serialize(f, result)
    end
    
    println("Done")
    flush(stdout)
end

if abspath(PROGRAM_FILE) == @__FILE__
    main(ARGS)
end

using Statistics

const _CHIRAL_ELEMENTS = Set(["C", "S"])

function _find_chiral_centres(mol)
    chiral_centres = FindMolChiralCenters(mol, force=true, includeUnassigned=false, useLegacyImplementation=true)
    
    atom_name_by_idx = Dict(GetIdx(atom) => GetProp(atom, "atom_name") for atom in GetAtoms(mol))
    
    atom_chirality_by_name = Dict(atom_name_by_idx[k] => v for (k, v) in chiral_centres)
    
    return Dict(
        k => v
        for (k, v) in atom_chirality_by_name
        if any(uppercase(k[1:min(length(k), length(el))]) == el for el in _CHIRAL_ELEMENTS)
    )
end

function _chiral_match(mol1, mol2)
    mol1_atom_names = Set(GetProp(a, "atom_name") for a in GetAtoms(mol1))
    mol2_atom_names = Set(GetProp(a, "atom_name") for a in GetAtoms(mol2))
    
    if mol1_atom_names != mol2_atom_names
        if !issubset(mol1_atom_names, mol2_atom_names)
            error("Mol1 atoms are not a subset of mol2 atoms.")
        end
    end
    
    mol1_chiral_centres = _find_chiral_centres(mol1)
    mol2_chiral_centres = _find_chiral_centres(mol2)
    
    if Set(keys(mol1_chiral_centres)) != Set(keys(mol2_chiral_centres))
        if !issubset(Set(keys(mol1_chiral_centres)), keys(mol2_chiral_centres))
            return false
        end
    end
    
    chirality_matches = Dict(
        centre_atom => (chirality1 == mol2_chiral_centres[centre_atom])
        for (centre_atom, chirality1) in mol1_chiral_centres
        if "?" != mol2_chiral_centres[centre_atom]
    )
    
    return all(values(chirality_matches))
end

function _mol_from_ligand_struc(ligand_struc, ref_mol)
    if num_residues(ligand_struc, count_unresolved=true) > 1
        error("ligand_struc has more than one residue.")
    end
    
    coords_by_atom_name = Dict(zip(ligand_struc.atom_name, ligand_struc.coords))
    
    ref_mol = sanitize_mol(ref_mol, sort_alphabetically=false, remove_hydrogens=true)
    
    mol = Mol(ref_mol)
    RemoveAllConformers(mol)
    
    atom_indices_to_remove = [
        GetIdx(a)
        for a in GetAtoms(mol)
        if !(GetProp(a, "atom_name") in keys(coords_by_atom_name))
    ]
    
    editable_mol = EditableMol(mol)
    
    for atom_idx in reverse(atom_indices_to_remove)
        RemoveAtom(editable_mol, atom_idx)
    end
    
    mol = GetMol(editable_mol)
    conformer = Conformer(GetNumAtoms(mol))
    
    for (atom_idx, atom) in enumerate(GetAtoms(mol))
        atom_name = GetProp(atom, "atom_name")
        coords = coords_by_atom_name[atom_name]
        SetAtomPosition(conformer, atom_idx, collect(coords))
    end
    
    AddConformer(mol, conformer)
    
    try
        AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
    catch e
        if occursin("Cannot normalize a zero length vector", string(e))
            return nothing
        else
            rethrow(e)
        end
    end
    
    return mol
end

function _maybe_mol_from_ccd(res_name::String)
    ccd = Ccd()
    ccd_cif = get(ccd, res_name)
    
    if isnothing(ccd_cif)
        @warn "No ccd information for residue $res_name."
        return nothing
    end
    
    try
        mol = mol_from_ccd_cif(ccd_cif, force_parse=false)
    catch e
        if isa(e, MolFromMmcifError)
            @warn "Failed to create mol from ccd for $res_name: $e"
            return nothing
        else
            rethrow(e)
        end
    end
    
    if isnothing(mol)
        error("Failed to create mol from ccd for $res_name.")
    end
    
    mol = sanitize_mol(mol, sort_alphabetically=false, remove_hydrogens=true)
    
    return mol
end

function compare_chirality(test_struc, ref_mol_by_chain=nothing)
    ref_mol_by_chain = something(ref_mol_by_chain, Dict())
    test_struc = filter_to_entity_type(test_struc, ligand=true)
    name = test_struc.name
    
    chiral_match_by_chain_id = Dict{String, Bool}()
    
    for chain_id in test_struc.chains
        chain_struc = filter(test_struc, chain_id=chain_id)
        
        if num_residues(chain_struc, count_unresolved=true) > 1
            @warn "$name: Chain $chain_id has >1 residues. Skipping."
            continue
        end
        
        if !(chain_id in keys(ref_mol_by_chain))
            ref_mol = _maybe_mol_from_ccd(chain_struc.res_name[1])
        else
            ref_mol = ref_mol_by_chain[chain_id]
        end
        
        if isnothing(ref_mol)
            @warn "$name: Ref mol is None for chain $chain_id. Skipping."
            continue
        end
        
        mol = _mol_from_ligand_struc(ligand_struc=chain_struc, ref_mol=ref_mol)
        
        if isnothing(mol)
            @warn "$name: Failed to create mol for chain $chain_id. Skipping."
            continue
        end
        
        chiral_match_by_chain_id[chain_id] = _chiral_match(mol, ref_mol)
    end
    
    return chiral_match_by_chain_id
end

using LinearAlgebra

const ArrayT = Any
const ScalarInt = Union{Int, Int32, Int64}

function load_block(ref, idx::Vector; block_shape::Vector, other=nothing, kwargs...)
    idx_adj, mask = _get_block_indexer_and_mask(ref, idx, block_shape=block_shape)
    
    if isa(ref, ArrayView)
        idx_adj = ref[idx_adj...].offsets
        ref = ref.base
    end
    
    other = mask === nothing ? other : other
    
    return pl_load(ref, idx_adj, mask=mask, other=other; kwargs...)
end

function store_block(ref, val, idx::Vector; block_shape=nothing, kwargs...)
    if block_shape === nothing
        block_shape = collect(size(val))
    end
    
    idx_adj, mask = _get_block_indexer_and_mask(ref, idx, block_shape=block_shape)
    
    if isa(ref, ArrayView)
        idx_adj = ref[idx_adj...].offsets
        ref = ref.base
    end
    
    pl_store(ref, idx_adj, convert(eltype(ref), val), mask=mask; kwargs...)
end

function in_bounds_mask(idx::Vector, shape::Vector; check=nothing)
    if check === nothing
        check = fill(true, length(shape))
    end
    
    shape_filtered = [dim for (i, dim) in enumerate(shape) if !isa(idx[i], Int)]
    check_filtered = [chk for (i, chk) in enumerate(check) if !isa(idx[i], Int)]
    idx_filtered = [idx_val for idx_val in idx if !isa(idx_val, Int)]
    
    mask = nothing
    
    for (i, (dim_idx, dim, chk)) in enumerate(zip(idx_filtered, shape_filtered, check_filtered))
        if !chk
            continue
        end
        
        if isa(dim_idx, UnitRange)
            dim_idx_arr = collect(dim_idx)
        elseif isa(dim_idx, AbstractArray)
            if ndims(dim_idx) != 1
                error("Only one-dimensional indices are supported.")
            end
            dim_idx_arr = dim_idx
        else
            dim_idx_arr = [dim_idx]
        end
        
        bcast_axes = [a for a in 1:length(shape_filtered) if a != i]
        dim_mask = reshape(dim_idx_arr .< dim, tuple(setdiff(1:length(shape_filtered), bcast_axes)...))
        
        mask = mask === nothing ? dim_mask : (mask .& dim_mask)
    end
    
    return mask
end

function _get_block_indexer_and_mask(ref, idx::Vector; block_shape::Vector)
    shape = size(ref)
    idxs = []
    check = Bool[]
    
    for (dim, block_idx, block_dim) in zip(shape, idx, block_shape)
        if block_dim === nothing
            push!(idxs, block_idx)
            push!(check, false)
        else
            push!(idxs, (block_dim * block_idx):(block_dim * (block_idx + 1) - 1))
            push!(check, dim % block_dim != 0)
        end
    end
    
    return (tuple(idxs...), in_bounds_mask(idxs, collect(shape), check=check))
end

    global_config
    name::String
    
    function ConfidenceHead(config, global_config; name="confidence_head")
        new(config, global_config, name)
    end
end

function _embed_features(self::ConfidenceHead, dense_atom_positions, token_atoms_to_pseudo_beta, pair_mask, pair_act, target_feat)
    out = Linear(size(pair_act)[end], name="left_target_feat_project")(target_feat)
    out = convert(eltype(pair_act), out)
    
    out = out .+ convert(eltype(pair_act), Linear(size(pair_act)[end], name="right_target_feat_project")(target_feat)[:, :])
    
    positions = convert_layout(token_atoms_to_pseudo_beta, dense_atom_positions, layout_axes=(-3, -2))
    
    dgram = dgram_from_positions(positions, self.config.dgram_features)
    
    dgram = dgram .* pair_mask[:, :, :]
    
    out = out .+ Linear(size(pair_act)[end], name="distogram_feat_project")(convert(eltype(pair_act), dgram))
    
    return out
end

function call_confidence_head(self::ConfidenceHead, dense_atom_positions, embeddings, seq_mask, token_atoms_to_pseudo_beta, asym_id)
    dtype = self.global_config.bfloat16 == "all" ? Float16 : Float32
    
    seq_mask_cast = convert(Array{dtype}, seq_mask)
    pair_mask = seq_mask_cast[:, :] .* seq_mask_cast[:, :]'
    pair_mask = convert(Array{dtype}, pair_mask)
    
    pair_act = convert(Array{dtype}, embeddings["pair"])
    single_act = convert(Array{dtype}, embeddings["single"])
    target_feat = convert(Array{dtype}, embeddings["target_feat"])
    
    num_residues = size(seq_mask)[1]
    num_pair_channels = size(pair_act)[3]
    
    pair_act = pair_act .+ _embed_features(self, dense_atom_positions, token_atoms_to_pseudo_beta, pair_mask, pair_act, target_feat)
    
    function pairformer_fn(act)
        pair_act_inner, single_act_inner = act
        return PairFormerIteration(
            self.config.pairformer,
            self.global_config,
            with_single=true,
            name="confidence_pairformer"
        )(
            act=pair_act_inner,
            single_act=single_act_inner,
            pair_mask=pair_mask,
            seq_mask=seq_mask
        )
    end
    
    pairformer_stack = layer_stack(self.config.pairformer.num_layer)(pairformer_fn)
    pair_act, single_act = pairformer_stack((pair_act, single_act))
    pair_act = convert(Array{Float32}, pair_act)
    
    @assert size(pair_act) == (num_residues, num_residues, num_pair_channels)
    
    left_distance_logits = Linear(
        self.config.num_bins,
        initializer=self.global_config.final_init,
        name="left_half_distance_logits"
    )(LayerNorm(name="logits_ln")(pair_act))
    
    right_distance_logits = left_distance_logits
    distance_logits = left_distance_logits .+ permutedims(right_distance_logits, (2, 1, 3))
    
    distance_breaks = range(0.0, self.config.max_error_bin, length=self.config.num_bins - 1)
    step = distance_breaks[2] - distance_breaks[1]
    bin_centers = collect(distance_breaks) .+ step / 2
    bin_centers = vcat(bin_centers, [bin_centers[end] + step])
    
    distance_probs = softmax(distance_logits, dims=3)
    pred_distance_error = sum(distance_probs .* reshape(bin_centers, 1, 1, :), dims=3)[:, :, 1] .* pair_mask
    
    average_pred_distance_error = sum(pred_distance_error) / sum(pair_mask)
    
    pae_outputs = Dict()
    
    pae_logits = Linear(
        self.config.pae.num_bins,
        initializer=self.global_config.final_init,
        name="pae_logits"
    )(LayerNorm(name="pae_logits_ln")(pair_act))
    
    pae_breaks = range(0.0, self.config.pae.max_error_bin, length=self.config.pae.num_bins - 1)
    step = pae_breaks[2] - pae_breaks[1]
    bin_centers = collect(pae_breaks) .+ step / 2
    bin_centers = vcat(bin_centers, [bin_centers[end] + step])
    
    pae_probs = softmax(pae_logits, dims=3)
    seq_mask_bool = Bool.(seq_mask)
    pair_mask_bool = seq_mask_bool[:, :] .* seq_mask_bool[:, :]'
    pae = sum(pae_probs .* reshape(bin_centers, 1, 1, :), dims=3)[:, :, 1] .* pair_mask_bool
    
    pae_outputs["full_pae"] = pae
    
    tmscore_adjusted_pae_global, tmscore_adjusted_pae_interface = _get_tmscore_adjusted_pae(
        self,
        asym_id=asym_id,
        seq_mask=seq_mask,
        pair_mask=pair_mask_bool,
        bin_centers=bin_centers,
        pae_probs=pae_probs
    )
    
    pae_outputs["tmscore_adjusted_pae_global"] = tmscore_adjusted_pae_global
    pae_outputs["tmscore_adjusted_pae_interface"] = tmscore_adjusted_pae_interface
    
    single_act = convert(Array{Float32}, single_act)
    
    plddt_logits = Linear(
        (size(dense_atom_positions)[2], self.config.num_plddt_bins),
        initializer=self.global_config.final_init,
        name="plddt_logits"
    )(LayerNorm(name="plddt_logits_ln")(single_act))
    
    bin_width = 1.0 / self.config.num_plddt_bins
    bin_centers = collect(0.5 * bin_width:bin_width:(1.0 - 0.5 * bin_width))
    
    predicted_lddt = sum(softmax(plddt_logits, dims=3) .* reshape(bin_centers, 1, 1, :), dims=3)[:, :, 1]
    predicted_lddt = predicted_lddt .* 100.0
    
    experimentally_resolved_logits = Linear(
        (size(dense_atom_positions)[2], 2),
        initializer=self.global_config.final_init,
        name="experimentally_resolved_logits"
    )(LayerNorm(name="experimentally_resolved_ln")(single_act))
    
    predicted_experimentally_resolved = softmax(experimentally_resolved_logits, dims=3)[:, :, 2]
    
    return Dict(
        "predicted_lddt" => predicted_lddt,
        "predicted_experimentally_resolved" => predicted_experimentally_resolved,
        "full_pde" => pred_distance_error,
        "average_pde" => average_pred_distance_error,
        pae_outputs...
    )
end

function _get_tmscore_adjusted_pae(self::ConfidenceHead; asym_id, seq_mask, pair_mask, bin_centers, pae_probs)
    function get_tmscore_adjusted_pae(num_interface_tokens, bin_centers, pae_probs)
        clipped_num_res = max.(num_interface_tokens, 19)
        d0 = 1.24 .* (clipped_num_res .- 15).^(1.0 / 3) .- 1.8
        d0 = reshape(d0, size(d0)..., 1)
        bin_centers_reshaped = reshape(bin_centers, 1, 1, :)
        tm_per_bin = 1.0 ./ (1 .+ (bin_centers_reshaped.^2) ./ (d0.^2))
        predicted_tm_term = sum(pae_probs .* tm_per_bin, dims=3)[:, :, 1]
        return predicted_tm_term
    end
    
    x = asym_id[:, :] .== asym_id[:, :]'
    num_chain_tokens = sum(x .* pair_mask, dims=2)[:, 1]
    num_interface_tokens = num_chain_tokens[:, :] .+ num_chain_tokens[:, :]'
    num_interface_tokens = num_interface_tokens .- (x .* (num_interface_tokens .÷ 2))
    num_interface_tokens = num_interface_tokens .* pair_mask
    
    num_global_tokens = fill(sum(seq_mask), size(pair_mask))
    
    global_apae = get_tmscore_adjusted_pae(num_global_tokens, bin_centers, pae_probs)
    interface_apae = get_tmscore_adjusted_pae(num_interface_tokens, bin_centers, pae_probs)
    
    return global_apae, interface_apae
end

using DataStructures

struct ChemCompEntry
    type::String
    name::String
    pdbx_synonyms::String
    formula::String
    formula_weight::String
    mon_nstd_flag::String
    pdbx_smiles::Union{String, Nothing}
    
    function ChemCompEntry(type, name="?", pdbx_synonyms="?", formula="?", formula_weight="?", mon_nstd_flag="?", pdbx_smiles=nothing)
        for (field, value) in [("type", type), ("name", name), ("pdbx_synonyms", pdbx_synonyms), 
                                ("formula", formula), ("formula_weight", formula_weight), 
                                ("mon_nstd_flag", mon_nstd_flag)]
            if value == "" && value !== nothing
                error("$field value can't be an empty string.")
            end
        end
        new(type, name, pdbx_synonyms, formula, formula_weight, mon_nstd_flag, pdbx_smiles)
    end
end

function extends(self::ChemCompEntry, other::ChemCompEntry)
    for field in fieldnames(ChemCompEntry)
        value = getfield(self, field)
        other_value = getfield(other, field)
        
        if _value_is_missing(other_value)
            continue
        end
        
        if value != other_value
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

function rdkit_mol(self::ChemCompEntry)
    if isnothing(self.pdbx_smiles) || self.pdbx_smiles == ""
        error("Cannot construct RDKit Mol with empty pdbx_smiles")
    end
    return MolFromSmiles(self.pdbx_smiles)
end

const _REQUIRED_MMCIF_COLUMNS = ("_chem_comp.id", "_chem_comp.type")

struct MissingChemicalComponentsDataError <: Exception
    msg::String
end

struct ChemicalComponentsData
    chem_comp::Dict{String, ChemCompEntry}
end

function from_mmcif(::Type{ChemicalComponentsData}, cif, fix_mse::Bool, fix_unknown_dna::Bool)
    for col in _REQUIRED_MMCIF_COLUMNS
        if !(col in keys(cif))
            throw(MissingChemicalComponentsDataError(col))
        end
    end
    
    id_ = cif["_chem_comp.id"]
    type_ = cif["_chem_comp.type"]
    name = get(cif, "_chem_comp.name", fill("?", length(id_)))
    synonyms = get(cif, "_chem_comp.pdbx_synonyms", fill("?", length(id_)))
    formula = get(cif, "_chem_comp.formula", fill("?", length(id_)))
    weight = get(cif, "_chem_comp.formula_weight", fill("?", length(id_)))
    mon_nstd_flag = get(cif, "_chem_comp.mon_nstd_flag", fill("?", length(id_)))
    smiles = get(cif, "_chem_comp.pdbx_smiles", fill("?", length(id_)))
    smiles = [s == "?" ? nothing : s for s in smiles]
    
    chem_comp = Dict{String, ChemCompEntry}()
    for (component_name, entry...) in zip(id_, type_, name, synonyms, formula, weight, mon_nstd_flag, smiles)
        chem_comp[component_name] = ChemCompEntry(entry...)
    end
    
    if fix_mse && "MSE" in keys(chem_comp)
        if !("MET" in keys(chem_comp))
            chem_comp["MET"] = ChemCompEntry(
                "L-PEPTIDE LINKING",
                "METHIONINE",
                "?",
                "C5 H11 N O2 S",
                "149.211",
                "y",
                nothing
            )
        end
    end
    
    if fix_unknown_dna && "N" in keys(chem_comp)
        if !("DN" in keys(chem_comp))
            chem_comp["DN"] = ChemCompEntry(
                "DNA LINKING",
                "UNKNOWN 2'-DEOXYNUCLEOTIDE",
                "?",
                "C5 H11 O6 P",
                "198.111",
                "y",
                nothing
            )
        end
    end
    
    return ChemicalComponentsData(chem_comp)
end

function to_mmcif_dict(self::ChemicalComponentsData)
    mmcif_dict = Dict{String, Vector{String}}()
    mmcif_fields = Set{String}()
    
    for entry in values(self.chem_comp)
        for field in fieldnames(ChemCompEntry)
            value = getfield(entry, field)
            if !isnothing(value) && value != ""
                push!(mmcif_fields, string(field))
            end
        end
    end
    
    chem_comp_ids = String[]
    
    for component_id in sort(collect(keys(self.chem_comp)))
        entry = self.chem_comp[component_id]
        push!(chem_comp_ids, component_id)
        
        for field in mmcif_fields
            field_sym = Symbol(field)
            if field_sym in fieldnames(ChemCompEntry)
                value = getfield(entry, field_sym)
                if !haskey(mmcif_dict, "_chem_comp.$field")
                    mmcif_dict["_chem_comp.$field"] = String[]
                end
                push!(mmcif_dict["_chem_comp.$field"], isnothing(value) || value == "" ? "?" : string(value))
            end
        end
    end
    
    if !isempty(chem_comp_ids)
        mmcif_dict["_chem_comp.id"] = chem_comp_ids
    end
    
    return mmcif_dict
end

function _value_is_missing(value)
    return isnothing(value) || value == "" || value in (".", "?")
end

function get_data_for_ccd_components(ccd, chemical_component_ids, populate_pdbx_smiles::Bool=false)
    chem_comp = Dict{String, ChemCompEntry}()
    
    for chemical_component_id in chemical_component_ids
        chem_data = component_name_to_info(ccd, chemical_component_id)
        
        if isnothing(chem_data)
            continue
        end
        
        chem_comp[chemical_component_id] = ChemCompEntry(
            chem_data.type,
            chem_data.name,
            chem_data.pdbx_synonyms,
            chem_data.formula,
            chem_data.formula_weight,
            chem_data.mon_nstd_flag,
            populate_pdbx_smiles ? (isnothing(chem_data.pdbx_smiles) ? nothing : chem_data.pdbx_smiles) : nothing
        )
    end
    
    return ChemicalComponentsData(chem_comp)
end

function populate_missing_ccd_data(ccd, chemical_components_data::ChemicalComponentsData, chemical_component_ids=nothing, populate_pdbx_smiles::Bool=false)
    if isnothing(chemical_component_ids)
        chemical_component_ids = keys(chemical_components_data.chem_comp)
    end
    
    ccd_data = get_data_for_ccd_components(ccd, chemical_component_ids, populate_pdbx_smiles)
    
    chem_comp = copy(chemical_components_data.chem_comp)
    
    for (component_id, ccd_entry) in ccd_data.chem_comp
        if !(component_id in keys(chem_comp))
            chem_comp[component_id] = ccd_entry
        else
            already_specified_fields = Dict{Symbol, Any}()
            for field in fieldnames(ChemCompEntry)
                value = getfield(chem_comp[component_id], field)
                if !_value_is_missing(value)
                    already_specified_fields[field] = value
                end
            end
            
            merged_fields = merge(
                Dict(field => getfield(ccd_entry, field) for field in fieldnames(ChemCompEntry)),
                already_specified_fields
            )
            
            chem_comp[component_id] = ChemCompEntry(
                merged_fields[:type],
                merged_fields[:name],
                merged_fields[:pdbx_synonyms],
                merged_fields[:formula],
                merged_fields[:formula_weight],
                merged_fields[:mon_nstd_flag],
                merged_fields[:pdbx_smiles]
            )
        end
    end
    
    return ChemicalComponentsData(chem_comp)
end

function get_all_atoms_in_entry(ccd, res_name::String)
    if res_name == "UNK"
        res_name = "GLY"

    ccd_data = get(ccd, res_name, nothing)

    keys_list = (

        append!(res_atoms["_chem_comp_atom.atom_id"], ["H2", "H3"])
        append!(res_atoms["_chem_comp_atom.type_symbol"], ["H", "H"])
        append!(res_atoms["_chem_comp_bond.atom_id_1"], ["N", "N"])
        append!(res_atoms["_chem_comp_bond.atom_id_2"], ["H2", "H3"])
    elseif res_name in PROTEIN_TYPES_WITH_UNKNOWN

using DataStructures

struct Bonds
    key::Vector{Int64}
    type::Vector{String}
    role::Vector{String}
    from_atom_key::Vector{Int64}
    dest_atom_key::Vector{Int64}
end

function make_empty(::Type{Bonds})
    return Bonds(
        Int64[],
        String[],
        String[],
        Int64[],
        Int64[]
    )
end

function get_atom_indices(self::Bonds, atom_key::Vector{Int64})
    from_atom_missing = .!(in.(self.from_atom_key, Ref(Set(atom_key))))
    dest_atom_missing = .!(in.(self.dest_atom_key, Ref(Set(atom_key))))
    
    if any(from_atom_missing)
        error("No atoms for from_atom_key $(self.from_atom_key[from_atom_missing])")
    end
    
    if any(dest_atom_missing)
        error("No atoms for dest_atom_key $(self.dest_atom_key[dest_atom_missing])")
    end
    
    sort_indices = sortperm(atom_key)
    from_indices_sorted = searchsortedfirst.(Ref(atom_key[sort_indices]), self.from_atom_key)
    dest_indices_sorted = searchsortedfirst.(Ref(atom_key[sort_indices]), self.dest_atom_key)
    
    from_indices = sort_indices[from_indices_sorted]
    dest_indices = sort_indices[dest_indices_sorted]
    
    return from_indices, dest_indices
end

function restrict_to_atoms(self::Bonds, atom_key::Vector{Int64})
    if length(self.key) == 0
        return self
    end
    
    atom_key_set = Set(atom_key)
    from_atom_mask = in.(self.from_atom_key, Ref(atom_key_set))
    dest_atom_mask = in.(self.dest_atom_key, Ref(atom_key_set))
    mask = from_atom_mask .& dest_atom_mask
    
    return Bonds(
        self.key[mask],
        self.type[mask],
        self.role[mask],
        self.from_atom_key[mask],
        self.dest_atom_key[mask]
    )
end

function to_mmcif_dict_from_atom_arrays(
    self::Bonds,
    atom_key::Vector{Int64},
    chain_id::Vector{String},
    res_id::Vector,
    res_name::Vector{String},
    atom_name::Vector{String},
    auth_asym_id::Vector{String},
    auth_seq_id::Vector,
    insertion_code::Vector{String}
)
    mmcif_dict = DefaultDict{String, Vector}(() -> [])
    
    ptnr1_indices, ptnr2_indices = get_atom_indices(self, atom_key)
    
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr1_label_asym_id"] = chain_id[ptnr1_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr2_label_asym_id"] = chain_id[ptnr2_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr1_label_comp_id"] = res_name[ptnr1_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr2_label_comp_id"] = res_name[ptnr2_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr1_label_seq_id"] = res_id[ptnr1_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr2_label_seq_id"] = res_id[ptnr2_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr1_label_atom_id"] = atom_name[ptnr1_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr2_label_atom_id"] = atom_name[ptnr2_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr1_auth_asym_id"] = auth_asym_id[ptnr1_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr2_auth_asym_id"] = auth_asym_id[ptnr2_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr1_auth_seq_id"] = auth_seq_id[ptnr1_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr2_auth_seq_id"] = auth_seq_id[ptnr2_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.pdbx_ptnr1_PDB_ins_code"] = insertion_code[ptnr1_indices]
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.pdbx_ptnr2_PDB_ins_code"] = insertion_code[ptnr2_indices]
    
    label_alt_id = fill("?", length(self.key))
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.pdbx_ptnr1_label_alt_id"] = label_alt_id
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.pdbx_ptnr2_label_alt_id"] = label_alt_id
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.pdbx_value_order"] = fill("?", length(self.key))
    
    symmetry = fill("1_555", length(self.key))
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr1_symmetry"] = symmetry
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.ptnr2_symmetry"] = symmetry
    
    bond_type_counter = counter(String)
    
    for i in 1:length(self.key)
        bond_type = self.type[i]
        bond_type_counter[bond_type] += 1
        push!(mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.id"], "$(bond_type)$(bond_type_counter[bond_type])")
        push!(mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.pdbx_role"], self.role[i])
        push!(mmcif_dict["_struct_conn.conn_type_id"], bond_type)
    end
    
    bond_types = unique(self.type)
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn_type.id"] = bond_types
    unknown = fill("?", length(bond_types))
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn_type.criteria"] = unknown
    mmcif_dict["_struct_conn_type.reference"] = unknown
    
    return Dict(mmcif_dict)

function concat_with_atom_keys(bonds_tables::Vector, atom_key_arrays::Vector)
    if isempty(bonds_tables) || isempty(atom_key_arrays)
        if !isempty(bonds_tables) || !isempty(atom_key_arrays)
            error("bonds_tables and atom_keys must have same length but got length(bonds_tables)=$(length(bonds_tables)) and length(atom_key_arrays)=$(length(atom_key_arrays))")
        end
        return nothing, Int64[]
    end
    
    max_key = -1
    atom_keys_to_concat = []
    types_to_concat = []
    roles_to_concat = []
    from_atom_keys_to_concat = []
    dest_atom_keys_to_concat = []
    
    for (bonds, atom_key) in zip(bonds_tables, atom_key_arrays)
        if isempty(atom_key)
            @assert isnothing(bonds) || isempty(bonds.key)
            continue
        end
        
        @assert minimum(atom_key) >= 0
        
        offset = max_key + 1
        offset_atom_key = atom_key .+ offset
        push!(atom_keys_to_concat, offset_atom_key)
        max_key = maximum(offset_atom_key)
        
        if !isnothing(bonds)
            push!(types_to_concat, bonds.type)
            push!(roles_to_concat, bonds.role)
            push!(from_atom_keys_to_concat, bonds.from_atom_key .+ offset)
            push!(dest_atom_keys_to_concat, bonds.dest_atom_key .+ offset)
        end
    end
    
    if !isempty(atom_keys_to_concat)
        concatenated_atom_keys = vcat(atom_keys_to_concat...)
    else
        concatenated_atom_keys = Int64[]
    end
    
    if !isempty(types_to_concat)
        @assert length(types_to_concat) == length(roles_to_concat) == length(from_atom_keys_to_concat) == length(dest_atom_keys_to_concat)
        
        num_bonds = sum(isnothing(b) ? 0 : length(b.key) for b in bonds_tables)
        
        concatenated_bonds = Bonds(
            collect(0:num_bonds-1),
            vcat(types_to_concat...),
            vcat(roles_to_concat...),
            vcat(from_atom_keys_to_concat...),
            vcat(dest_atom_keys_to_concat...)
        )
    else
        concatenated_bonds = nothing
    end
    
    return concatenated_bonds, concatenated_atom_keys
end
